_comment: Platform module catalog — the single structural source of truth for what a 'module' is. A module bundles its frontend route, the ADK agents it needs, the extra backend services it requires, and any platform capabilities it switches on. Tenants enable a set of modules (see tenants/<id>.json); enabling a module flips its frontend nav/routes, its agents (ENABLED_AGENTS), and its infra services together. Consumed natively by Terraform (jsondecode), start_services.sh (jq), and the frontend (via scripts/gen-tenant-config.mjs). Keep agent/service names exactly matching the adk_agents/<name> dirs and the docker-compose / cloudrun service names.

core._comment: Always deployed for every tenant, regardless of enabled modules.
